info.name: CampusFlow API - Phase 2
info.description: Version-controlled API tests for CampusFlow authentication and owned CRUD resources. Run folders in order. Postman keeps the HttpOnly session cookie in its cookie jar.

item.name: 00 - Health
item.description: Verify that Express and MySQL are available before running CRUD requests.

request.description: Expected to confirm both the API and MySQL connection.

exec: pm.test('API and database are healthy', function () {

item.name: 01 - Authentication
item.description: Register, restore, destroy, and recreate a server-side session. Set auth_password in the active environment before running this folder.

request.description: Generates a unique local test email, creates a user, and lets Postman store the HttpOnly session cookie automatically.

exec: pm.test('Registered public profile is returned', function () {

request.description: Uses the cookie created during registration to restore the authenticated user.

exec: pm.test('Session belongs to the registered user', function () {

request.description: Destroys the current server-side session and clears the cookie.
Confirms that the destroyed session can no longer access a protected endpoint.
Creates a new server-side session for the registered test user.

exec: pm.test('Logged-in public profile is returned', function () {
pm.test('New session cookie is created', function () {
